name: Common Snapping Turtle
description:
The common snapping turtle (*Chelydra serpentina*) is a large freshwater turtle of the family Chelydridae. Its natural range extends from southeastern Canada, southwest to the edge of the Rocky Mountains, as far east as Nova Scotia and Florida. This turtle species is noted for its combative disposition when out of the water with its powerful beak-like jaws, and highly mobile head and neck (hence the specific name serpentina, meaning “snake-like”). In water, they are likely to flee and hide themselves underwater in sediment.

This specimen was donated to the Nature Lab by Whitefoord Russell Cole III

Accession number: 121.23

Captured by Vija Lietuvninkas (MID '25) and Elise Williams (Sculpture '25) with an Artec Spider 3D Scanner https://www.artec3d.com/portable-3d-scanners/artec-spider-v2

description:

Het onderzoek maakt deel uit van de herinrichting van de Alkmaarder Hout, waarbij het voormalige parkeer- en helikopterterrein teruggegeven wordt aan het stadspark. Dit 3D-model toont één van de opgegraven structuren in detail en kan vrij bekeken worden in VR en AR.

name: Bugatti Circuit 2017 layout
description:
The Bugatti Circuit is a permanent race track located within the legendary Circuit des 24 Heures and named after Ettore Bugatti.

Due to the age and condition of Autodrome de Linas-Montlhéry, a search was conducted in the early 1960s for a location for a permanent race circuit and test track. Eventually the idea of using the section of the Le Mans 24 hour circuit that did not use public roads was hit upon. A plan for a 4.4 km permanent circuit was created, using the pit straight and first corner of the circuit, and looping back through various campgrounds and parking lots of the property. The track opened in 1965, having taken only a few months to construct. The original layout was 4.430 km long.

![](https://www.tinseau.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4047/2023/12/circuit-bugatti-le-mans-tinseau-test-days-track-days-02.jpg)

name: WrestleMania 37 Remastered Stage Design
description:
This project is a fan-made 3D recreation inspired by the stage design of WrestleMania 37, one of the biggest annual professional wrestling events organized by WWE.

The stage was modeled in Autodesk Maya with the goal of capturing the large-scale spectacle and themed environment of a WrestleMania arena entrance stage.

The design takes inspiration from the pirate-themed stage concept used at WrestleMania 37, featuring elements such as a large entrance structure, LED display areas, stage platforms, and a long entrance ramp designed for wrestler entrances during the event.

This project focuses on 3D environment creation and live event stage design, demonstrating how large arena stages can be built and visualized in a real-time 3D environment.

🔧 Software Used
Autodesk Maya – modeling and scene layout
📦 File Format
FBX
🎯 Possible Uses :
Game environment design
Virtual arena scenes
Event stage visualization
Sports entertainment environments

name: Paurakirche - Church of the Holy Trinity
description:
The pilgrimage church of Stadl-Paura is located in the municipality of Stadl-Paura in Upper Austria. According to legend, Abbot Maximilian Pagl of Lambach Abbey vowed to have a church built if the plague spared Lambach. Since it was considered to have been eradicated on Christmas Day 1713, the abbot requested permission to build the chapel in a letter dated January 2, 1714, in order to fulfill his promise. 

The Church is considered the “Church of the Holy Trinity” because its entire architecture and furnishings are based on the symbolism of the number three: the floor plan is a circle within an equilateral triangle, with three towers at the corners housing the sacristy, confessional, and St. Mary's Chapel, three entrances with three altars opposite each other, and three organs. The triangular lantern on the dome also emphasizes this concept, so that the building visibly refers to the Trinity in every form.

Captured in 336 images using a Dji mini 4, processed with RealityCapture and edited in Blender.

name: Struktur Rumah Tinggal Bertingkat Tipe 95
description:
Model 3D ini menampilkan struktur utama Rumah Tinggal Bertingkat Tipe 95 yang digunakan sebagai media pembelajaran pada mata pelajaran Estimasi Biaya Konstruksi. Model mencakup elemen-elemen struktur bangunan mulai dari pondasi hingga rangka atap, yaitu pondasi batu kali, footplate, sloof, kolom, balok, plat lantai, dinding, ring balok, tangga, serta rangka atap.

Setiap komponen struktur dirancang untuk memperlihatkan hubungan antar elemen dalam sistem konstruksi bangunan bertingkat serta fungsi masing-masing elemen dalam menyalurkan beban bangunan secara aman menuju tanah dasar. Model ini juga dilengkapi dengan informasi dan anotasi yang dapat membantu pengguna memahami fungsi, karakteristik, serta dasar perhitungan volume pekerjaan konstruksi.

Model dikembangkan sebagai bagian dari media pembelajaran berbasis Augmented Reality (AR) untuk mendukung pemahaman peserta didik terhadap struktur bangunan dan proses estimasi biaya konstruksi secara visual, interaktif, dan kontekstual.

name: Dragon Head with Human Form
description:
Introducing a captivating fusion of mythical majesty and human grace, behold the breathtaking 3D masterpiece: a dragon head seamlessly melded with a human form. This extraordinary creation encapsulates the essence of fantasy and imagination, showcasing the union of two worlds in a harmonious dance of artistry.

The dragon head, meticulously sculpted with intricate details, exudes an air of ancient wisdom and raw power. Its scales shimmer with an otherworldly iridescence, capturing the play of light in a mesmerizing display. The ferocious gaze of the dragon is rendered with an intensity that commands respect, while sharp, curving horns accentuate its regal presence.Yet, seamlessly emerging from the draconic visage is the human form, a testament to the symbiotic relationship between strength and vulnerability. The transition from scales to skin is executed with finesse, seamlessly blending the two entities into a singular, awe-inspiring entity The human face, adorned with a thoughtful expression all showcased.

name: Christmas Lights
description:
This asset is a customizable curve-driven LED ornament made with Geometry Nodes (Blender).

You can easily edit the curve to change the shape of the light strip or create a completely new curve and apply the same geometry node system.

The light colors are fully adjustable, allowing you to create endless variations (warm white, cold white, blue, etc.) to match any scene or holiday style.

For better visualisation, I recommend activating the glare filter in the compositing tab and activating the composition view in the layout.

Perfect for Christmas scenes, festive environments, street decorations, or glowing ornamental details.

name: Capitel, Claustro de la Colegiata de Santillana
description:
**ESP** Capitel doble figurado románico (s. XII) procedente del claustro de la Colegiata de Santa Juliana de Santillana del Mar (Cantabria, España). Representa el conocido pasaje del Antiguo Testamento del profeta Daniel en el pozo de los leones, mientras que el lado orientado al interior de la galería dle claustro podría representar el Sueño de Nabucodosor.

**ENG** Double Romanesque figurative capital (12th century) from the cloister of the Collegiate Church of Santa Juliana in Santillana del Mar (Cantabria, Spain). It depicts the well-known passage from the Old Testament about the prophet Daniel in the lions' den, while the side facing the interior of the cloister gallery could represent Nebuchadnezzar's dream.

The structure includes its own integral abutment stonework but no surrounding terrain, allowing it to be placed into any river, ravine, or forest environment.

name: sofa_lshape
description:
A high-quality, game-ready sofa designed for real-time applications such as video games, architectural visualization, and interactive environments. The model features optimized topology with efficient edge flow, ensuring strong performance without compromising visual fidelity.

The asset is built using a physically based rendering (PBR) workflow, including detailed textures for albedo, normal, roughness, and ambient occlusion. Subtle fabric patterns, stitching details, and realistic cushioning enhance the overall authenticity of the piece.

Carefully unwrapped UVs maximize texture resolution while minimizing seams, making it suitable for both close-up shots and background placement. The sofa is fully optimized for modern game engines like Unity and Unreal Engine, with a balanced polygon count and clean geometry.

Ideal for interior scenes, living room setups, and modern environments, this asset combines realism and performance, making it production-ready for professional use.

name: Qantara pyramidion
description:
# **Qantara Pyramidion
   
This object was discovered at the end of the 19th century at the site known as Tell Abu Seifi in Qantara. It was found in two pieces, which were later joined together. Initially, it was transferred to the Port Said Museum, then moved to the Ismailia Museum, where it was displayed in the garden. Eventually, it was relocated to the Suez Canal Museum in Ismailia.

The pyramidion originally stood inside the Temple of Horus, lord of Mesen, the eastern frontier city of Qantara. It was dedicated by Ramesses II. Based on the evidence, this city appears to have been located at Tell Abu Seifi in eastern Qantara. Ongoing excavations at the eastern frontier sites in Sinai are expected to reveal the lost city of Mesen soon.

name: Mammoth Tusk, T1. Cerney Wick 2025
description:
Mammoth Tusk found during the 2025 excavations of the ice age  (200,000+ years ago) site at Cerney Wick, Gloucestershire, UK.

This tusk measures 2.3 metres long in the extent shown here, the tip of the tusk was missing. A mammoth skull fragment was found in association with the tusk and had been lifted previously. This is the tusk from Trench 1, named by some "Hamish" after the person who found it ;-) . Initial indentification suggests it is from a Steppe Mammoth.

I quickly photographed for this model as the tusk and the ground around it was being prepared for plaster jacketing in order to lift it.

Photographed: 1 August 2025
Model built using Agisoft Metashape 2.2.1 (Standard edition)

In 1983, hikers near Marlowe, Pennsylvania stumbled upon a grotesque organism unlike any known species. name: Ammonite - Hildoceras sp.
description:
**Nom** : *Hildoceras sp.*

**Descrition** : Les ammonites pyriteuses sont le résultat d’un processus de fossilisation inhabituel : la pyritisation. Ce phénomène se produit lorsque les sédiments environnants sont pauvres en oxygène, créant un environnement anoxique favorable à la formation de pyrite (FeS₂) autour et dans les coquilles fossiles. Dans ce milieu, la matière organique se décompose lentement, permettant aux minéraux ferreux présents dans les eaux de sédimentation de remplacer la coquille d’origine, formant ainsi un moulage en pyrite.

**Dimensions** : 4,1 cm x 3,5 cm x 1,4 cm.

**Âge** : Toarcien, Jurassique inférieur.

**Localité** : inconnue.

**Méthode** : Acquisition de 509 photos avec Appareil Reflexe APS-C dans Studio Photos. Balance des blancs et colorimétrie par CaptureOne et Colorchecker. Modèle reconstruit par photogrammétrie.

**Réalisation** : Yann Ternois - SIGéo - CEREGE - OSU PYTHEAS - Aix-Marseille Université - Juillet 2026.

name: Elysa Fraser mausoleum, Cluny, Scotland
description:
Elyza Fraser (1736–1814), owner of Castle Fraser, was an independent and cultured Aberdeenshire landowner whose life was shaped by both privilege and loss. Born Elizabeth Fraser, youngest child of Charles Fraser of Inverallochy and Ann Udny, she was known as Elyza after an elder sister of the same name died in infancy. Her family suffered deeply in the Jacobite rising and later imperial wars, with two brothers killed at Culloden and Quebec.

Her mausoleum and tomb commemorate a woman remembered for intellect, refinement, determination and duty, and form an important physical link to one of Castle Fraser’s most influential female lairds.  

This tomb within the Elysa Fraser mausoleum commemorates Frederick MacKenzie Fraser born on 4 April 1831, in Cluny. He married Marie Augusta Gabrielle Berengere Blanche Drummond on 24 April 1871, in Argyll, Scotland. He died on 19 May 1897, in Castle Fraser, Cluny, Aberdeenshire, Scotland, at the age of 66.

name: Etruscan seal (left humerus)
description:
3D scan of the left humerus of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: Statue Baron Taylor
description:
*Bienvenue à toi, cher visiteur,

Tu te tiens devant la dernière demeure de l’illustre Baron Taylor, figure oubliée mais ô combien essentielle du XIXe siècle.
Homme de théâtre, voyageur passionné, défenseur infatigable du patrimoine… 
C’est aussi grâce à lui que l’obélisque de Louxor a quitté les rives du Nil pour venir trôner sur la place de la Concorde, témoin silencieux d’un lien entre l’Orient et Paris.
Si tu souhaites percer les mystères de sa vie et de son héritage, rends-toi au cimetière du Père Lachaise, où le temps semble suspendu.
En attendant, contemple ce modèle 3D, fidèle reconstitution de sa tombe : un mausolée sobre et élégant, orné d’un buste figé dans la pierre, flanqué de colonnes et de détails néo-classiques. Un monument à la mémoire d’un homme dont les œuvres continuent de murmurer à ceux qui prennent le temps d’écouter.
*

**NB : Ce projet a été réalisé dans le cadre de la licence professionnelle LPUEG de Sorbonne Université, par M. Alessandro Blasetti.**

name: Albert Park Circuit Melbourne 2018 layout
description:
The Albert Park Circuit is a motorsport street circuit around Albert Park Lake in the suburb of Albert Park in Melbourne. It is used annually as a circuit for the Formula One Australian Grand Prix, the supporting Supercars Championship Melbourne SuperSprint and other associated support races. The circuit has an FIA Grade 1 licence.

Although the entire track consists of normally public roads, each sector includes medium to high-speed characteristics more commonly associated with dedicated racetracks facilitated by grass and gravel run-off safety zones that are reconstructed annually. However, the circuit also has characteristics of a street circuit's enclosed nature due to concrete barriers annually built along the Lakeside Drive curve, in particular, where run-off is not available due to the proximity of the lake shore.

She started on th Helsinki- Stockholm route in SIlja's livery and was the largest cruise ferry afloat in 1993.

Here the Silja Europa is in her forst Silja Line colors. Nowadays she is in Tallink's colors and in a long term charter in the Netherlands.

name: Ogden Laundry Building
description: Built in 1913, the Ogden Block has has been the home to many in its 110 year history. For the first few years of the buildings existence the Hong Lee Laundry operated out of the storefront while also serving as a boarding house for Chinese immigrants. From around 1916-1918 the building may have been used by the Ogden Military Convalescent Hospital, housing injured and disabled veterans. From 1922 until 2021 the building had switched owners over a dozen times, seeing use as a family home and as a rental property. In 2021 the City of Calgary purchased the building, and although the Ogden Block has cultural and historical value, it does not meet the requirements to be a protected. As a consequence, it is set to be demolished to make way for the proposed Green Line Transit System.

name: Rambi the Rhino – Donkey Kong Country

Fan sculpt of Rambi the Rhino from the original Donkey Kong Country (1994).
My goal was to recreate the look of the old CGI render style from Rare’s pre-rendered era, staying true to the chunky forms, soft lighting, and plastic-like shading typical of that time.

Sculpted and polypainted in Blender, aiming to capture the expressive and toy-like feel of the SNES promotional models rather than the in-game low-poly.
No retopo, no PBR — just pure 90s charm. 🦏💾

name: Railway Signal Box - Bytom, Poland
description:
The railway signal box "Bt", located in Bytom is one of the few preserved overhead signal boxes in Poland. It was built in the 1930s and gained its current form after a rebuilding that likely took place in the 1970s. Due to the modernization of the Bytom station, it was taken out of service in 2022. 

The building has since been renovated, but I decided to recreate it in its pre-renovation state, as it offers a great opportunity to develop my texturing skills. To achieve the best possible result, this time I decided to use a higher texel density (3px/cm instead of 1-1.5px), and I carefully recreated the peeling paint entirely by hand. Working on this model taught me not to be overly perfectionistic and to know when to say “stop” — because trust me, you could keep tweaking the details forever!

name: Bear-Shaped Pig
description:
# Woodcarving Collection
### Bear-Shaped Pig

> * Beech wood
> * Linseed oil finish
> * Completed on 20th July 2025

I started this wanting to carve a simple cat, but early on it was clear that I picked an overly thick piece of wood. I tried to turn it into a pig, but it seems like the wood was too thick for that too. The wide body and rounded legs make it look more like a bear from every side, other than the one initially shown on the 3D model, where it vaguely resembles a pig. 

It isn't great, but I hope that, in a few years, it'll be a good indicator of how far I've come with my carving skills.


**Shot with Autogrammetry v1.0**

name: Parasauroluphus
description: Parasaurolophus was a large, herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, around 76 to 73 million years ago. It belonged to the hadrosaur family, often called "duck-billed dinosaurs." Parasaurolophus is most famous for its long, backward-curving cranial crest, which may have been used for communication, display, and possibly thermoregulation. It could reach lengths of up to 10 meters (33 feet) and likely roamed in herds, feeding on plants and moving between forested and open environments. Fossils of Parasaurolophus have been found in North America, particularly in regions of Canada and the United States.

name: ⚠️ Your 3D Art May Be at Risk ⚠️
description:
To all artists, creators, and collectors on Sketchfab:

This post is intended to raise awareness about a risk that affects 3D content shared online. Some model-extraction and graphics-capture tools can be used to obtain geometry and textures from content that is rendered on a user's device. As a result, even models that are intended primarily for viewing may be vulnerable to unauthorized copying.

Many creators invest countless hours, days, or even months into producing high-quality 3D artwork. Unauthorized extraction, redistribution, or commercial use of these works can undermine that effort and harm the artists who make this community possible.

Please respect creators' intellectual property, licensing terms, and permissions. If you discover unauthorized copies of your work, consider reporting them through the appropriate channels and documenting the infringement.

The purpose of this message is to encourage awareness, discussion, and better protection of digital artwork within the Sketchfab community.

name: Терраса - 2 Ян, Алексей. С лесенкой.
description: Терраса NestoDom с лесенкой  — это современное архитектурное решение в формате пристройки примыкающей к дому, со ступенями из ЛСТК для спуска на газон, сочетающее в себе капитальную надежность и технологичность сборки. Несущий каркас выполнен на базе массивных опор-колонн из стальной профильной трубы проектного сечения (черный металл), что гарантирует максимальную устойчивость конструкции. Поверх силового основания монтируется высокоточная система из оцинкованного ЛСТК-профиля, разработанная специально для самостоятельной сборки без применения сварки. Оптимизированный шаг ферм в 600 мм обеспечивает идеальную плоскость и надежную опору для последующего монтажа террасной доски, а заводское качество всех элементов гарантирует долговечность и четкую геометрию пристройки на десятилетия.

name: The Scarred Courtyard of Mosul
description: This war-torn courtyard in Mosul’s Old Town stands as a silent witness to the city’s turbulent past. Once a vibrant space filled with life and traditional elegance, it now bears the deep scars of destruction. The colonnaded arcade, with its graceful arches and detailed stonework, showcases the rich architectural heritage of the region, despite the heavy damage. Bullet holes and graffiti mar the crumbling walls, while the collapsed sections expose the raw remnants of history. The central courtyard, once a place of gathering, is now littered with debris, a stark contrast to the grandeur it once held.

name: Beaver
description: Beavers (genus Castor) are large semiaquatic rodents of the Northern Hemisphere. There are two extant species: the North American beaver (Castor canadensis) and the Eurasian beaver (C. fiber). Beavers are the second-largest living rodents, after capybaras, weighing up to 50 kg (110 lb). They have stout bodies with large heads, long chisel-like incisors, brown or gray fur, hand-like front feet, webbed back feet, and tails that are flat and scaly. The two species differ in skull and tail shape and fur color. Beavers can be found in a number of freshwater habitats, such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds. They are herbivorous, consuming tree bark, aquatic plants, grasses and sedges.

from The Elder Scrolls IV Oblivion
The Minotaur (from Greek Μινώταυρος [Minótauros]) is a monster from Greek mythology, with the body of a man and the head of a bull. His name means "Bull of Minos", and he was the son of Pasiphae and the Bull of Crete. He was imprisoned in a labyrinth designed by the craftsman Daedalus, made expressly to retain him located in the city of Knossos on the island of Crete. For many years, seven men and seven other women were taken to the labyrinth as a sacrifice to be the beast's food, until its life ended at the hands of the hero Theseus. The fourteen young people were interned in the labyrinth, where they wandered lost until they were found by the Minotaur. The myth has its most complete version in the Mythological Library of Apollodorus.

name: Plaza de Armas Osorno
description:
La Plaza de Armas de Osorno nació en 1558 como el núcleo político de la ciudad. Tras la refundación de 1793, se consolidó como el centro neurálgico local. En la década de 1930, el paisajista Óscar Prager la modernizó con un diseño de estilo modernista, ejes en cruz y su icónico espejo de agua central. Hoy destaca como uno de los paseos públicos más verdes de Chile.

Modelo con fines académicos de la asignatura Laboratorio Digital Multimedia del tercer semestre de la carrera Diseño Digital Profesional Osorno, dirigido por el docente Marco Barría. Modelo Creado por Mateo Shibar y Tiffany Frendo.

name: Mid-Century Coastal Concrete Structure
description:
This 3D model represents a characteristic coastal concrete structure defined by a clear adaptation to uneven terrain. The design reflects a functional response to natural slope variations, where the supporting framework compensates for differences in elevation through a sequence of angular reinforcements and triangulated supports.
The mesh analysis reveals a deliberate distribution of load across inclined beams, emphasizing stability over ornamental detail. Subtle irregularities in the geometry suggest manual construction processes, typical of mid-20th century engineering practices, where precision was balanced with material limitations and on-site adjustments.

Today, the palace houses the most important collection of Austrian art – from medieval panels to works by Gustav Klimt.

name: elephant
description:
from "farcry4"
The Asian elephant (Elephas maximus) is a species of proboscis mammal in the Elephantidae family. It is the largest mammal in Asia. Its original distribution extends from southern China and western Indonesia to the coasts of the Persian Gulf and southern Mesopotamia, where it disappeared in the Neolithic period. It is currently limited to Sri Lanka, southern and northeastern India, Bangladesh, Indochina, Malacca, Sumatra, and northeastern Borneo. It is found both in the wild and domesticated and is very common in zoos and circuses. It is considered an endangered species. The Indian elephant has been domesticated since ancient times in Southeast Asia for the purpose of carrying loads, assisting in construction (usually carrying and lifting beams), or transporting people. In times of war, it has also been used to carry weapons and artillery pieces.

name: Neoceratodus (lungfish) Reconstruction
description:
Is there such a thing as a 'living fossil'? No, that's an oxymoron, but ***Neoceratodus fosteri*** (the Australian/Queensland lungfish) comes close! The strange pronged tooth-plates of this animal are almost identical to species found in Cretaceous rocks - these have since also been assigned to the genus ***Neoceratodus***.

This 3D skeletal reconstruction was created by [Astrid O'Connor](https://www.instagram.com/palaeoastrid/) in Blender (v3.4) through a combination of segmenting and processing a whole-body lungfish CT scan (**AMI 49438** by **Jessie Maisano** on **Morphosource** [here](http://www.morphosource.org/concern/media/000115978?locale=en)) to create the ossified bones, modelling the fins from the amazing free cartilage pectoral fin model (specimen **MCZ 157044** by **@tomstewartscience** [here](http://skfb.ly/6RBPz)), and additional sculpting work.

This reconstruction also aknowledges the incredible lungfish research by **Alice Clement**.

Blue = cartilage, opaque = lung, bronze = teeth.
tags: skeleton, fish, Fossil, lungfish, blender3d, sarcopterygii, neoceratodus

description:
Is there such a thing as a 'living fossil'? No, that's an oxymoron, but ***Neoceratodus fosteri*** (the Australian/Queensland lungfish) comes close! The strange pronged tooth-plates of this animal are almost identical to species found in Cretaceous rocks - these have since also been assigned to the genus ***Neoceratodus***.

This 3D skeletal reconstruction was created by [Astrid O'Connor](https://www.instagram.com/palaeoastrid/) in Blender (v3.4) through a combination of segmenting and processing a whole-body lungfish CT scan (**AMI 49438** by **Jessie Maisano** on **Morphosource** [here](http://www.morphosource.org/concern/media/000115978?locale=en)) to create the ossified bones, modelling the fins from the amazing free cartilage pectoral fin model (specimen **MCZ 157044** by **@tomstewartscience** [here](http://skfb.ly/6RBPz)), and additional sculpting work.

This reconstruction also aknowledges the incredible lungfish research by **Alice Clement**.

Blue = cartilage, opaque = lung, bronze = teeth.

description: This is a fairly rough reconstruction of the wall paintings on the north wall of the church of St Peter and St Paul in Hoxne, Suffolk, UK. The photos were taken in August 2023. Really, the main point of this reconstruction is to give some context to better images of the wall paintings. I'll give some links in the comments. name: farnsworth-house-glass-pavilion-v004-cityprompt
description:
A meticulously detailed, real-time ready 3D model of Mies van der Rohe's iconic Farnsworth House built in Blender. 

.glb asset is fully optimized for Three.js environments. The geometry features a highly organized node hierarchy with precise architectural naming for components like W8x48 steel columns and travertine terrace steps. It leverages advanced Khronos glTF extensions (KHR_materials_transmission, KHR_materials_ior) to deliver physically accurate glass refraction across the pavilion's signature curtain walls. The fully furnished interior includes authentic golden primavera wood core detailing and is illuminated by baked warm interior lighting (KHR_materials_emissive_strength), making it an ideal drop-in asset for high-fidelity urban planning or architectural renders.

name: Proyecto Monte Bello
description:
Modelo 3D Fotogramétrico de Terreno – Procesamiento UAV

Modelo tridimensional generado a partir de 154 imágenes aéreas capturadas con dron DJI Mini 3, mediante técnica de fotogrametría digital.

El procesamiento se realizó en Agisoft Metashape, siguiendo el flujo de trabajo:

Alineación de imágenes

Generación de nube de puntos densa

Construcción de malla (mesh)

Aplicación de textura

Generación de Modelo Digital de Terreno (MDT)

Extracción de curvas de nivel con intervalo de 0.5 m

El modelo permite la visualización detallada de la morfología del terreno y fue utilizado para análisis topográfico y representación altimétrica precisa.

Aplicaciones:

Análisis topográfico

Planificación territorial

Estudios preliminares de ingeniería

Generación de cartografía de detalle

name: Gilded Copper Phoenix Roof Ornament (铜鎏金凤凰脊兽)
description:
The Gilded Copper Phoenix Roof Ornament of the Qianlong reign in Qing Dynasty is a Class II national cultural relic standing 31.5 cm high. As an original roof component of the Hall of Unified Ten Thousand Dharma at Chengde’s Putuo Zongsheng Temple, it was cast in the 36th year of Qianlong’s reign. All gilded fittings on the hall’s roof consumed over 7,000 taels of gold, and this phoenix ornament was custom-made by the imperial workshop in the capital before being delivered to Chengde. Fully carved with scale, feather and cloud scroll patterns and coated with bright gilding, it bears inscriptions "Southwest, Xiang Six" on its base to record its original installation position and serial number, serving as a key physical artifact for studying Qing imperial bronze gilding craft, royal architectural rituals and ethnic integration history.

清乾隆铜鎏金凤凰脊兽为国家二级文物，通高 31.5 厘米，是承德普陀宗乘之庙万法归一殿原配屋顶构件，铸于乾隆三十六年，殿顶全套鎏金构件耗金七千余两，由京城造办处定制后运至承德。器物通体錾刻鳞羽卷云纹，鎏金光亮，底部刻 “西南、祥六” 铭文，标注原始安装方位与编号，是研究清代宫廷鎏金铸铜工艺、皇家建筑礼制与民族交融史的核心实物。

name: Stylized Assault Rifle - Scar
description:
Bonjour à tous !

Aujourd'hui je vous présente une nouvelle modélisation 3D d'un fusil d'assaut. Il s'agit d'une SCAR, qui est la première arme stylisée d'une longue série.

Cette modélisation m'a pris environ 6 à 8 heures, en comptant le concept art, la modélisation, les UVs, les textures, le rigging et une animation de tir unique, ainsi que le rechargement.

Pour ce projet, j'ai utilisé :

*     3DS MAX (Modélisation, Rigging, Animation)
*     Substance Painter (Textures)
*     Unreal Engine 5 (Rendu)
*     RizomUV (UV)

Dans le futur, il sera possible de télécharger certaines modélisations, ou bien d'acheter un pack d'armes stylisées.

name: 1972 Corvette Stingray
description:
The 1972 Corvette Stingray marked the final year of the chrome front and rear bumpers, giving it a distinct look before the Corvette’s styling began shifting toward a more modern aesthetic. Featuring the signature “shark” body lines introduced in 1968, the ’72 model carried forward the aggressive stance, sweeping curves, and hidden headlamps that defined the C3 generation. Under the hood, a range of powerful V8 engines was offered, embodying the muscle car era even as tightening emissions regulations loomed. This particular 3D scan, captured from the National Corvette Museum’s collection, preserves the Stingray’s iconic design details in digital form an enduring representation of one of America’s most celebrated sports cars.

For more information visit: [The National Corvette Museum](https://www.corvettemuseum.org/)

3D Scanned by: [Dockive](https://www.dockive.com/)

Every element of the V4 R is engineered to optimize speed, agility, and control, making it a formidable machine in the hands of skilled riders.

name: Halloween The Game - Judith Myers
description:
"Michael!"
―Judith Myers' last word

Judith Myers is a non-playable character in the 2026 video game Halloween.

Judith "Judy" Margaret Myers was born to Donald Myers and Edith Myers on November 10, 1947, in Russellville, Illinois. Her brother Michael was born in 1957, and her sister Cynthia was born in 1961. The family lived in a white, two-story house at 45 Lampkin Lane, in the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois.

On the night of October 31, 1963, Judith's parents went out, which left Michael in his sister's care, although she had planned to entertain her boyfriend.

At a few minutes to 10:00 PM, Michael found Judith combing her hair in front of her vanity, singing to herself, almost completely naked except for underwear. Judith then noticed Michael as he crept up behind her and spun around, calling his name in surprise. Michael then stabbed her multiple times in the chest, torso, and abdomen with a butcher knife. In pain, Judith screamed out loudly and fell to the floor mortally wounded.

name: Poppy
description:
Poppy es una pequeña hada que habita en Enchantia, un bosque lleno de magia antigua y criaturas luminosas. Llegó allí siendo apenas una bebé: alguien la dejó entre las raíces de un árbol sagrado y desapareció sin dejar rastro.
Los seres del bosque —duendes, luces errantes y espíritus guardianes— la encontraron, la protegieron y, movidos por su pureza, la transformaron en un hada para que pudiera vivir y crecer entre ellos.

Con el tiempo, Poppy se convirtió en la guardiana más dulce del bosque. Recorre Enchantia todos los días, cuidando a quienes lo habitan y asegurándose de que su magia siga fluyendo armoniosamente. Su misión es mantener vivo el encanto del bosque que la adoptó como una más de sus pequeñas guardianas.

description:
The left side of the face has that iconic monstrous, red cursed form with multiple glowing eyes embedded, giving him a terrifying and sinister look.
His smile is wide, sharp, and menacing, perfectly capturing Sukuna’s chaotic personality.
The musculature is very defined—broad chest, shredded abs, and thick arms, emphasizing his raw power.

Four arms are modeled (two extra sprouting from his sides), which adds to the menacing, supernatural aura. The proportions are balanced, making them feel natural to the character.
Each arm has dark bands wrapping around them, which matches his cursed aesthetic.
The additional mouth on the stomach is creepy and well-done, with sharp teeth and a tongue that looks ready to move.
Skin texture is gritty, with a rough, battle-worn look—adding realism.

The reddish rim lighting enhances his demonic presence.
Shadows bring out the muscular details and give him a 3D, intimidating depth.

name: Gen 1 Foxy, 1987 - (FNAF Rewritten 87)
description:
**This is the official release of the Withered Foxy model that I made for my game FNAF Rewritten: 87!**

"The mechanic we spoke to said that the project was cut short because the animatronics had deteriorated so much that they could not recover them. One specific horror story he shared was about when he was tasked with cutting into Foxy's torso. He said that he saw what he thought had to have been blood and the smell was the strongest compared any other part he had worked on. He told us that he was sure it had to be a rodent that must have gotten itself mixed up with the springlocks, which he said could have contributed to the springlock's recent stiffness. This aligns with rats being a common complaint amongst guests in the later years of the original Freddy's. It's surprising that one of the original co-founders was willing to return and refurbish them himself for the location that closed in 1993." -TFFFS

name: Gas3a (قصعة) — Traditional Moroccan Wooden Bowl
description:
Gas3a (قصعة) — Traditional Moroccan Wooden Bowl

This 3D model is a photogrammetry scan of a Gas3a, a traditional Moroccan wooden bowl crafted from very old Moroccan wood. The Gas3a is a iconic piece of Moroccan culinary heritage, most commonly used as the serving vessel for couscous — Morocco's national dish.

Handcrafted by skilled artisans, these bowls have been passed down through generations and remain a central element of Moroccan family gatherings and feasts. The aged wood texture and hand-carved form captured in this scan reflect centuries of craftsmanship and cultural identity.

📷 Captured using photogrammetry techniques to preserve the authentic details, texture, and patina of this antique object.

🌍 Part of an ongoing effort to digitally archive Moroccan traditional crafts and intangible cultural heritage.

description: A wooden face belonging to an anthropoid coffin lid, which is prepared with a thin layer of painted gesso as a ground for its polychrome decoration. The skin tone is rendered in a light brown pigment, with the eyes and eyebrows defined in bold black lines. Adorning the forehead is a decorative fillet (headband) painted in alternating patterns of green and red. The upper portion of the head features a series of parallel green stripes, representing a specific style of wig or headdress. The object contains four circular holes intended for wooden dowels to secure the face to the main coffin lid. There is noticeable wear and loss of gesso on the cheeks and nose, exposing the underlying timber core. This object dates to the Third Intermediate Period (c. 1069–715 BC).

name: Ammonite
description:
**Nostoceras sp. – Heteromorph Ammonite (Late Cretaceous)**
*Nostoceras* is an extinct genus of heteromorph ammonites that lived during the Late Cretaceous Period, approximately 83–72 million years ago (Campanian Stage). Unlike most ammonites with tightly coiled shells, *Nostoceras* possessed a distinctive helical shell with a characteristic U-shaped body chamber, making it one of the most recognizable heteromorph ammonites.
These marine cephalopods inhabited ancient seas and are known from fossil deposits worldwide. Their unusual shell morphology reflects the remarkable evolutionary diversity of ammonites before their extinction at the end of the Cretaceous Period.

This fossil specimen is housed in the Buhais Geology Park Collection, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates

name: The Royal Tombs - Petra, Jordan
description:
Carved into Petra’s sandstone cliffs, the Palace, Corinthian, and Silk Tombs are monumental 1st-century CE rock-cut mausoleums built by the Nabataeans. They epitomize the fusion of indigenous Nabataean design with Hellenistic (Greco-Roman) architectural influences. 

The Silk Tomb, named for the iridescent multicolored sandstone of its façade, is relatively small but visually striking. The adjacent Corinthian Tomb (c. 40–70 CE) features Corinthian columns and a central tholos, echoing Petra’s Treasury and underscoring strong Greco-Roman influence. The largest is the three-story Palace Tomb, so-called for its grand palace-like façade. 

Visit the "Petra Archaeological Park" collection [here](https://skfb.ly/pysMo)

Scanned by GDH in Nov. 2024 and May 2025. Processed using Z+F Laser Control, Reality Capture, Agisoft Metashape and Blender.

This project was a collaboration between the PDTRA, DoA, GDH, and ACOR.

name: Prinz-Eugen-Denkmal
description:
3D model of the Prince Eugene Equestrian Monument on Heldenplatz in Vienna

The monument honors the famous commander of the House of Austria, Prince Eugene of Savoy. The bronze sculpture was created by Anton Dominik Fernkorn and completed by his pupil Franz Pönninger. The Vienna Arsenal provided 448 hundredweights of ore for the casting.

The rectangular base with corner volutes rests on a pedestal with chamfered corners. It is decorated with inscription panels and bronze appliqués depicting figures, fruit, coats of arms and battle names. The Savoy coat of arms with lions is emblazoned on the back. The base, made of Untersberg Veitlbruch, is decorated with military equipment and a crescent moon. The imposing equestrian statue depicting Prince Eugene on a rearing horse rises on top.

On October 18, 1865, Prince Eugene's 202nd birthday, the monument was ceremoniously inaugurated by Emperor Franz Joseph I.

[See The Acadia Bridges in ArcGIS online](https://arcg.is/1uirLf1)

**Stanley Brook Bridge** was the last of the bridges built by John D. Rockefeller Jr. in Acadia National Park, on Mount Desert Island, Maine.

The bridge was constructed in 1933 and is the 16th of the 17 bridges on the Carriage Road network in the park. Like the other bridges, Stanley Brook is constructed of ashlar granite facing over a reinforced concrete substructure. It has 3 arches: the central and largest arch spans Stanley Brook Road motorway, while the two smaller arches span a footpath and Stanley Brook respectively.

name: Boule de Canton sur support en ivoire
description:
Casse-tête mécanique chinois en ivoire connu sous le nom de ***Boule de Canton*** sur son support.
D. 8 (boule) - H. 23 ; D. 7,5 (support), en cm
Symbole de bonne fortune et chef d'œuvre de tournage et de scultpture, il s'agit de sphères concentriques, mobiles les unes dans les autres, taillées dans un même bloc d'ivoire sans assemblage.
La sphère supérieure est décorée de dragons dans des entrelacs. Chaque sphère présente des vides circulaires également répartis permettant la manipulation des sphères inférieures. Elles sont finement ajourée à la manière d'un moucharabieh.
Le support en forme de coupe, figure un homme sur la moitié inférieure du pied. Au-dessus, un cylindre creux, à la surface finement ajourée, mobile autour de l'axe du pied.
N° d’inv. : 1957.1.451 issu des collections du musée des Cordeliers de Saint-Jean d'Angely (17 - France). [Voir la fiche dans notre base de données en ligne](https://www.alienor.org/collections/oeuvre/135592).

name: structure of pure methane clathrate
description:
1. The structure of pure methane clathrates resembles an arrangement of rods running in three mutually perpendicular directions. Consider where spheres could be placed within this structure.
2. The 5¹²6² cages form most readily. They bond together via their hexagonal faces to create rods. Voids bounded by pentagonal faces form between the rods; smaller cages—specifically of the 5¹² type—spontaneously appear there. When the rods grow rapidly, not all of these smaller cages manage to trap a methane molecule inside.
3. The yellow cube represents the unit cell. It can be seen that the 5¹² cages form a body-centered cubic lattice. Each unit cell contains one such cage at its center and one-eighth of a cage at each of the eight corners, resulting in a total of two cages.
4. Each of the three rods contributes four halves of 5¹²6² cages. Thus, there are two 5¹² cages for every six 5¹²6² cages.

name: Fracture and ankylosis of hip
description:
Right acetabulum and proximal femur of an adult female.

The midshaft of the femur has been fractured; the distal fragment has been displaced anteriorly and superiorly and there is approx. 73mm of shortening. There is angulation of the distal fragment approx. 20 degrees medial to the long axis of the shaft. Spurs of bone can be observed on the supero-anterior and infero-poterior parts of the fracture.

The acetabulum may also have sustained a fracture, just inferior to the arcuate line, as there are changes across the area for the *obturator internus* which give the pelvis a widened, swollen appearance. The femoral head has been driven backwards and up into the supero-posterior rim of the acetabulum where they have become ankylosed, with the femur protruding in a 'sitting' position. The degree of healing suggests that these injuries occurred long before the death of the individual, although their ability to walk would have been severely impaired.

name: AR-47 OMEGA – Heavy Marksman Rifle
description:
AR-47 OMEGA is a AAA-quality hero weapon created for a first-person shooter environment. Designed as a heavy marksman rifle, this asset was built with close-range player visibility in mind, ensuring a strong silhouette, material readability, and optimized performance.
The model was created in Maya (76K triangles) and structured using a UDIM workflow to maintain consistent texel density across prioritized areas. The center body, being most visible in first-person view, holds the highest texel detail, while the front assembly, magazine, grip, stock, and scope are distributed across dedicated UV sets for balanced resolution and optimization.
Texturing was completed in Adobe Substance 3D Painter with careful material separation between metal, rubber, plastic, and glass to enhance realism and surface storytelling. Renders were produced in Iray within Substance Painter, followed by subtle post-processing in Photoshop.

name: Ravager Axe 3D
description:
RABEGER AXE is a game-ready 3D melee weapon created for dark fantasy and survival-style games.

This asset was modeled in Blender, refined with sculpted details, and textured using a PBR workflow in Substance 3D Painter. The presentation focuses on realistic material definition, including worn steel, aged wood, leather bindings, and rusted metal details.

The model is optimized for real-time rendering and is intended as a portfolio piece demonstrating a complete game asset workflow.

Software Used:

Blender
ZBrush
Substance 3D Painter

Thank you for viewing my work. Feedback is always welcome!

name: Cannon

This is my first experience in 3D, so any feedback is welcome 🙂
